scope: Former fit130 invalid-to-valid events with target center outside the static 4x last-GT local crop; 245 cases.
construction: Square tiles of side ceil(max(image width,height)/grid), with 1x1, 2x2, or 3x3 evenly spaced top-left positions; each tile would be resized to 256x256.
limitation: GT is used only for this train-only geometric capacity audit. No tracker generates or ranks tiles, the target may be occluded, and full-box coverage with sufficient pixels does not imply a correct dense prediction or safe recovery.
